porto_novo.name: Porto Novo
porto_novo.description: A bustling harbor city, gateway to inland trade. Grain ships fill the docks.

al_manar.name: Al-Manar
al_manar.description: Ancient port famed for its spice markets. Merchants bid fiercely for grain and iron.

silva_bay.name: Silva Bay
silva_bay.description: Timber-rich bay surrounded by dense forests. The shipwrights here are the best in the region.

corsairs_rest.name: Corsair's Rest
corsairs_rest.description: A lawless harbor tucked between cliffs. Smugglers, pirates, and those who trade with them.

ironhaven.name: Ironhaven
ironhaven.description: Industrial port city wreathed in forge smoke. Weapons and iron flow out, everything else flows in.

stormwall.name: Stormwall
stormwall.description: Fortress port guarding the northern straits. Military outpost with strict inspections.

thornport.name: Thornport
thornport.description: Whaling town turned trading post. Tea and tobacco are the local currency. Medicines fetch gold.

sun_harbor.name: Sun Harbor
sun_harbor.description: Golden coast port where cotton bales stack higher than the warehouses.

palm_cove.name: Palm Cove
palm_cove.description: A sheltered cove where rum barrels outnumber the inhabitants. Cheapest provisions on the coast.

iron_point.name: Iron Point
iron_point.description: Mining settlement at the river mouth. Iron flows out, everything else flows in at a premium.

pearl_shallows.name: Pearl Shallows
pearl_shallows.description: Divers bring up pearls from the warm shallows. A quiet port where fortunes are made by the patient.

jade_port.name: Jade Port
jade_port.description: Porcelain workshops line the waterfront. Iron and grain are worth their weight in gold here.

monsoon_reach.name: Monsoon Reach
monsoon_reach.description: Seasonal winds funnel the spice trade through this crossroads. The shipyard builds for endurance.

silk_haven.name: Silk Haven
silk_haven.description: Premier silk market of the eastern waters. Rum and iron are scarce luxuries here.

crosswind_isle.name: Crosswind Isle
crosswind_isle.description: Free port at the junction of all trade winds. Everything passes through, nothing stays cheap.

dragons_gate.name: Dragon's Gate
dragons_gate.description: Fortress harbor controlling the eastern straits. Weapons are contraband here, but medicines are gold.

spice_narrows.name: Spice Narrows
spice_narrows.description: Hidden anchorage in the spice archipelago. The most concentrated spice market in the world.

ember_isle.name: Ember Isle
ember_isle.description: Volcanic island with obsidian beaches. Rich in rare minerals and medicinal plants.

typhoon_anchorage.name: Typhoon Anchorage
typhoon_anchorage.description: Storm-battered harbor that only the boldest captains visit. Pearls and rare goods reward the brave.

coral_throne.name: Coral Throne
coral_throne.description: Island kingdom built on coral reefs. The king trades pearls for weapons and demands tribute in silk.
